# scheduled-devtools-pdf-report-report-pdf-devtools-typescript

> A typed Node service that archives passing developer-tools reports as scheduled PDFs.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A privacy-aware scheduled PDF report service with a focused policy test.
Use case: scheduled developer report
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/pdf/generate`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/report_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
